data.title: PR-16 M03/M08 with stale epoch or timer carried in message or timer data

data.body: [HIGH] The summary makes two evidence-provenance claims that this range cannot support. It says the expectations preceded campaign execution and every earlier golden line stayed unchanged. The range first adds expected_carried at crates/continuum-asupersync/tests/support/register_mutants.rs:1105 and renders results at crates/continuum-asupersync/tests/pr16_impl05_mutants.rs:1952. Git history has no earlier tracked expectation anchor. The golden diff also rewrites existing M03 and M08 expected lines, so the preservation claim is false. Failure modes: An author can fit expected classifications after results exist, then publish both as pre-registered evidence. Edge cases: Re-blessing, seed changes, or expectation edits can keep generated evidence green while rewriting the claimed prior intent. Rollback: Remove both historical claims, or restore a verifiable expectation artifact that predates campaign execution. Monitoring: CI should bind results to an immutable expectation digest and reject unapproved edits to prior golden sections. Validation: Regenerate from the anchored expectation, compare the full golden diff, and independently replay both mutants and carrier baselines. Blocker: provide that prior anchor, or narrow the authoritative summary to commit-scoped observable results.

data.body: [INFO][risk:high] Failure modes: a reused process epoch or unchecked timer payload can confirm lost data and create an invalid acknowledgement. Edge cases: the range covers graceful and fail-stop crashes, absent carrier sites, accepted current-epoch recovery, multiple incarnations, full confirmation channels, and sampled silent plans. Rollback: revert this range to restore the explicit M03 and M08 exclusions without changing production state or schemas. Monitoring: keep golden drift, zero-finding carrier baselines, prior campaign identities, payload counts, and open Seal threads visible. Validation: static review traced carrier construction through scheduling, journal projection, property checks, witness replay assertions, and the corrected evidence claims. I did not rerun tests because this reviewer can write only Seal metadata. The separate risk:critical human gate remains required.
